source_notes: Rules transcribed from three user-supplied screenshots.
Supplementary screenshot adds R61 and R62 to section 3.2.

After merging the screenshots, section 3.2 contains 11 visible rules (R61,R62,R63,R64,R65,R66,R67,R74,R75,R76,R77) while the source header still declares 10. All visible rules are preserved; none is deleted to force the count to 10.
R96 and R99 reference three validation conditions, but the screenshot does not enumerate those three conditions; they remain unresolved until the user supplies them.
Red marker/highlight is preserved for R36, R37, R76 and R96.
All rules are research heuristics during the current multi-day Betfair shadow test and cannot alter formal-system statistics by themselves.

rules.name: 盈亏比均衡=市场成熟
rules.core_point: 三项盈亏比接近=市场交易充分
unresolved: 三项盈亏比接近的客观容差阈值未在截图定义

rules.name: 高概率低凯利=核心
rules.core_point: 概率>60%+凯利指数最低=真热

rules.name: 换手平稳=市场共识
rules.core_point: Back/Lay 价差<0.10+WoM 40-60%=真共识

rules.name: 深层 Back 大单=吃货
rules.core_point: 深层大单+占比>40%=大资金看好

rules.name: 卖方主动压价=不利
rules.core_point: WoM<35%+Lay 挂单远超 Back=看空
unresolved: Lay远超Back的倍率阈值未在截图定义

rules.name: 盈利率异常=市场方向
rules.core_point: 大小球盈利率偏离 2 倍标准差=顺市场

rules.name: Back 放量+高位挂单=硬吃
rules.core_point: 买方高价位主动挂单=真金白银看好
unresolved: 高位定义与主动挂单识别规则未在截图定义

rules.name: 凯差离散度偏高=扭曲
rules.core_point: 凯差偏离 1.5 倍标准差=赔率被扭曲

rules.name: 凯差热指低位=安全
rules.core_point: 机构赔付风险可控=真实概率
unresolved: 凯差热指低位阈值未在截图定义

rules.name: 中间价位空白=无人区
rules.core_point: Back/Lay 中间空白=谁推谁被吃
rules.candidate_proxy: spread_ticks>1 可作为中间价位存在空档的候选代理，但不得等同原规则结论

rules.name: 量价背离=信号
rules.core_point: 成交方向与赔率变化方向不一致=隐藏力
rules.current_feed_note: OddsPapi tradedVolume only gives volume, not matched-side direction; do not fabricate trade direction.

rules.name: 线索矛盾→警惕第三选项
rules.core_point: ≥2 维度互相矛盾=答案在盲区

rules.name: “过于完美”=诱盘信号
rules.core_point: 热门选项数据完美但有表演感=诱盘
unresolved: 表演感无法由截图给出客观阈值，禁止自动硬判

rules.name: 对立选项无支撑=主方向加强
rules.core_point: 真热+对立选项连反抗都没有=主方向可信

rules.name: 放量下行=强势确认
rules.core_point: 成交放量+价位下行=买方压倒性优势
rules.current_feed_note: Can be evaluated only from at least two valid pre-match snapshots for the same runner.

rules.name: 庄家自救盘
rules.core_point: 必发>80%集中+盘口不调整=庄家控盘
rules.language_guard: The phrase 庄家控盘 is preserved from the source rule and must be treated as a hypothesis label, not a verified fact.

rules.name: 控盘成本阈值
rules.core_point: 顶级赛事操纵成本高概率低，友谊赛反
rules.language_guard: Manipulation is not inferred as fact without independent evidence.

rules.name: 多庄博弈盘
rules.core_point: 多大资本抢夺控制权→先观察保守为好
unresolved: 大资本/控制权的客观识别阈值未在截图定义

rules.name: 诱盘验证三条件
rules.core_point: 盘口持续受捧≠诱盘，需验证三条件
unresolved: 截图未列出三条具体验证条件，禁止猜测

rules.name: 反向指标使用条件
rules.core_point: 散户热度≠总是反向，三条件验证后判断
unresolved: 截图未列出三条具体验证条件，禁止猜测
